name: Yamaha YZF-R3
engine: 321 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected
intro: Yamaha's small sport twin. Early bikes had several recalls, so check them all before you start.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2015-2018 R3s were in radiator hose recall 18V861, and 2015-2016 bikes also had recalls for the shifter spring (18V860), clutch bearing, fuel tank bracket and ignition switch.
A-002.reason: Several of these can stall the bike or leak coolant. All repairs are free.

recalls.what: Upper radiator hose may crack and leak coolant.
recalls.fix: Dealer fits a new hose free.

recalls.what: Gear shift return spring may break.
